name: State Bank of India
product: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) — crop and allied credit
scopeLabel: Public sector bank · check local branch
borrower: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, eligible SHGs/JLGs
amountNote: Calculated from crop pattern, cultivated area and District Level Technical Committee Scale of Finance.
rate: SBI page lists concessional rates up to ₹3 lakh subject to Government interest-subvention support; confirm current rate.
summary: Revolving cash-credit for cultivation, post-harvest, household consumption, farm-asset maintenance and eligible allied activities.
purpose: Crop working capital, post-harvest, farm assets and allied activities.
eligibility: Individual/joint owner cultivators; tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers and eligible farmer SHGs/JLGs; subject to documentation and SOF.
terms: SBI page states up to 5 years with 10% annual step-up subject to annual review. Crop-linked repayment applies. Confirm current collateral/security limits.
documents: Land/cultivation proof or accepted tenant/sharecropper/JLG documentation
Additional security/guarantor papers if required by branch
process: Check eligibility and current district/crop Scale of Finance.
Apply through the official SBI KCC route where enabled or visit an SBI agriculture branch.
Submit KYC, land/cultivation and crop/acreage information.
Branch verifies cultivation, calculates the limit and completes credit appraisal.
Review sanction amount, rate, charges and repayment terms before accepting.
availability: Check SBI branch coverage and crop SOF in selected district
reviewNote: SBI page last updated 25 Aug 2025; reconfirm rate and security terms.
caution: Published rates and collateral thresholds may change. Request current rate card, fees, KFS and security terms from the branch.

name: Bank of Baroda
scopeLabel: Public sector bank · check local branch
borrower: Farmers including eligible tenants and sharecroppers
amount: ₹5,000 minimum; maximum assessed by crop, land and bank appraisal
amountNote: The product page publishes a ₹5,000 minimum; no universal maximum is inferred.
rate: Product page states 7% p.a. up to ₹3 lakh subject to Government interest subvention; verify current pricing.
summary: Digital KCC for production credit and investment credit, subject to current BKCC terms.
purpose: Production credit and eligible farm investment.
eligibility: Farmers including tenant farmers and sharecroppers, subject to documentation and branch verification.
terms: Product page states a 5-year validity. Interest subvention, collateral, fees and renewal must be checked in current MITC.
documents: Land/cultivation proof or accepted tenant/sharecropper documentation
Bank account information and any documents specified by the branch
process: Open the BKCC official product page and choose Apply Online or contact an agri branch.
Complete the application and provide KYC, land and crop information.
Bank verifies borrower, crop/area, credit history and security.
Review sanction terms, interest, charges and repayment before signing.

sources.label: Baroda Kisan Credit Card official page

reviewNote: Request current MITC and the latest interest schedule.
caution: The 7% rate is conditional on Government interest subvention. It is not a guaranteed rate for every amount or applicant.

name: Canara Bank
scopeLabel: Public sector bank · check local branch

amount: KCC need-based; investment products assessed individually

rate: Current rate depends on product and borrower; check live rate and charges schedule.
summary: Product catalogue includes KCC, SHGs, custom hiring, cold storage, rural godowns, agri-GST, hi-tech agriculture, processing, drone and farm machinery finance.

eligibility: KCC includes owner farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers and eligible farmer SHGs/JLGs. Each investment product has separate criteria.

documents: Land/cultivation and crop details for KCC
Quotation/project report for equipment or infrastructure
FPO/SHG/company registrations and accounts where required
process: Choose the relevant Canara scheme from the AgriLoans page.
Open/download the product terms and review margin, collateral, subsidy and eligible borrower.
Apply online if a product journey exists or approach a Canara agriculture branch.
Submit KYC, land/crop or project papers for verification and appraisal.
Obtain written sanction and confirm rate, charges and repayment schedule.
availability: Subject to branch and named product
reviewNote: The bank page lists separate product sheets; inspect the current one for the selected loan.
caution: The catalogue includes different borrowers such as individual farmers, SHGs and enterprises. It is not a single blanket farmer loan.

FPO/SHG documents and statements where relevant

Download and review current scheme terms for limit, margin, collateral, interest and repayment.
Apply through any linked digital route or visit a PNB agriculture/rural branch.
Submit scheme-specific documents for verification and appraisal.
Read the sanction letter/KFS before accepting.

reviewNote: The bank page was last updated 29 May 2026 and links individual scheme documents.

No-dues or other documents where scheme requires

Submit KYC, land extracts, crop/project details and any required no-dues certificate.
Confirm sanction, interest, collateral and repayment terms.

caution: The Kisan Tatkal page publishes specific conditions and is not an open-to-everyone cash loan. Confirm branch availability.

name: Indian Bank

Crop, acreage and district SOF details

Upload KYC, land/cultivation and crop details.
Branch checks eligibility and sets the crop-wise limit using district SOF.
Review sanctioned amount, interest, fees and repayment terms.

name: UCO Bank
product: KCC and UCO Kisan Tatkal Scheme
scopeLabel: Public sector bank · check local branch
borrower: Farmers; Kisan Tatkal is only for eligible existing KCC holders
amount: KCC need-based; Kisan Tatkal ₹10,000–₹1,00,000 as shown on bank page

rate: Kisan Tatkal page states Base Rate without interest subvention; verify current schedule.

purpose: Crop, post-harvest, marketing and allied working capital; eligible emergency household/farming needs under Kisan Tatkal.
eligibility: KCC: owner farmers, tenants, oral lessees, sharecroppers and eligible SHGs/JLGs. Kisan Tatkal: existing KCC holder with satisfactory two-year track record.

documents: Existing KCC and repayment history for Kisan Tatkal
Additional papers requested by the branch
process: Open Agriculture Credit and choose KCC or Kisan Tatkal.
For Kisan Tatkal, confirm eligible existing KCC and repayment history first.
Apply through the available digital or branch route.
Branch checks purpose, account conduct, security and repayment capacity.
Obtain the written current terms before accepting.
reviewNote: Kisan Tatkal amount shown as published on the UCO Bank product page; recheck current policy.
caution: Kisan Tatkal is not open to every farmer. It is a separate product for qualifying existing KCC borrowers.
